text:
SDP::media
Description
This command allows you to get or set different aspects of the media
information for your SDP connection.
Syntax
SDP::media attr <media-index> <attr-index>
SDP::media count
SDP::media <media-index>
SDP::media type <media-index>
SDP::media port <media-index>
SDP::media port <media-index> “new value"
SDP::media transport <media-index>
SDP::media conn <media-index>
SDP::media conn <media-index> “new value”
SDP::media
attr <media-index> <attr-index>
Get SDP attribute attr-index of media media-index e.g.
SDP::media
attr 0 1 will get SDP attribute 1 of media 0
SDP::media
count
Return the number of medias
SDP::media
<media-index>
Get SDP media at index media-index
SDP::media
type <media-index>
Get SDP media type of media media-index
SDP::media
port <media-index>
Get SDP media port of media media-index
SDP::media
port <media-index> “new value”
Rewrite SDP media port of media media-index
SDP::media
transport <media-index>
Get SDP media transport info of media media-index (e.g. RTP/AVP)
SDP::media
conn <media-index>
Get SDP media connection info of media media-index if its available,
else gets connection info of session.
SDP::media
conn <media-index> “new value”
Rewrite SDP media connection info of media media-index
